entries.tests/*.client.mjs: the test files of vitest.client.config.ts (its test.include)

packages/validator/ts.reason: an npm workspace whose Vitest configuration enables the typecheck mode (test.typecheck), whose test files the Vitest plugin of knip does not read: the plugin reads test.include and not typecheck.include

entries.src/**/*.test-d.ts: the type test files that the typecheck mode of Vitest checks (the default typecheck.include of Vitest)

packages/form-binding.reason: an npm workspace whose build script runs tsup inside the command that scripts/package-dist.mts receives as one quoted argument, which knip does not parse

ignoreDependencies.tsup: the build script runs `tsup src/index.ts --format esm` through scripts/package-dist.mts

packages/react.reason: an npm workspace whose package.json exports "." and "./server" are dist files that tsup builds from src/index.ts and src/server.ts; the type RenderListOptions that src/server.ts re-exports is the option type of the public renderList of ./server, as the svelte and vue entries re-export it

entries.src/index.ts: the package entry: package.json exports "." is dist/index.mjs and dist/index.js, which tsup builds from src/index.ts
entries.src/server.ts: the server entry: package.json exports "./server" is dist/server.mjs and dist/server.js, which tsup builds from src/server.ts

packages/generator/ts.reason: an npm workspace whose tsconfig.json checks the sources and the tests and emits nothing: it has no rootDir or outDir, as its tests import the shared scenario of tests/fixtures/form-session from outside the package (C14.40), so knip cannot map the dist files of package.json exports to src; tsconfig.build.json emits the declarations from src. Its entries replace the default entries of knip

entries.src/index.ts: the package entry: package.json exports "." is dist/index.mjs and dist/index.js, which tsup builds from src/index.ts
entries.src/internal.ts: the internal entry: package.json exports "./internal" is dist/internal.mjs and dist/internal.js, which tsup builds from src/internal.ts
